versions.changelog:
Huawei Cloud ASM fuzzy mesh list skill — initial release.

- Lists all ASM (Application Service Mesh) meshes in the current tenant/project via the official Python SDK (`huaweicloudsdkasm`).
- Supports client-side, case-insensitive name fuzzy matching (substring match) for filtering meshes.
- Returns mesh name, mesh id, status phase, and creation timestamp for each matching mesh.
- Read-only access: never creates, modifies, or deletes any mesh or resource.
- Only supported in the `cn-north-4` region.
